summary: Japan International Cooperation Agency filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $1 billion 4.375% guaranteed bond due May 28, 2031, guaranteed by Japan. The bonds are issued at 99.530% of par, with underwriting discount of 0.125%. Net proceeds will finance eligible sustainability projects. The bonds will be listed on SGX-ST and settle via DTC, Euroclear, Clearstream. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. Underwriters include Daiwa, Barclays, Goldman Sachs, HSBC.
